rules.label: Sneak Attack (+damage of a Commando of your level)
rules.damage: 1 + min(1, floor(@level / 4)) + min(1, floor(@level / 8)) + min(1, floor(@level / 13)) + min(1, floor(@level / 17)) + min(1, floor(@level / 20))

automation.notes: Roll Options Dialog: on attacks, a Sneak Attack switch adds bonus damage equal to a Commando's Sneak Attack at your level. Turn it on only when the target is within 30ft and isn't fully aware of you, and you have a use left this combat (one per combat).

source.book: Factions in Action Vol 1: Ferocious Fighters
